/-- An additive action is isometric if each map `x ↦ c +ᵥ x` is an isometry. -/
class IsIsometricVAdd (X : Type w) [PseudoEMetricSpace X] [VAdd M X] : Prop where
  isometry_vadd (X) : ∀ c : M, Isometry ((c +ᵥ ·) : X → X)
